system.description:
The character is small, light, and unobtrusive. They are easy to miss and can be easily hidden.

  • Level 1: +1 to Stealth and related rolls
  • Level 2: +2 to Stealth and related rolls
  • Level 3: +3 to Stealth and related rolls
  • Level 4: +4 to Stealth and related rolls
  • Level 5: +5 to Stealth and related rolls
  • Level 6: +6 to Stealth and related rolls
